parts.t: Yaletown condos for sale include modern high-rises, luxury apartments, and waterfront residences in one of Downtown Vancouver’s most vibrant neighbourhoods. Browse updated MLS® listings with photos, prices, and building details close to restaurants, shopping, and the seawall. Yaletown is one of Vancouver’s most sought-after neighbourhoods, known for its waterfront living, luxury high-rises, and walkable lifestyle. Residents enjoy close access to the seawall, world-class dining, boutique shopping, and downtown employment centres.

The Yaletown condo market offers a mix of modern glass towers, waterfront residences, and upscale buildings with premium amenities. Buyers are drawn to the convenience, strong long-term value, and vibrant urban atmosphere that defines this area.
Whether you're looking for a first home, investment property, or luxury waterfront condo, Yaletown continues to be one of the most desirable places to live in Downtown Vancouver.
Work with local Realtor Jared Gibbons for expert advice and private condo showings throughout Yaletown.

Yaletown represents Vancouver's most coveted downtown neighbourhood, where heritage warehouse conversions meet modern high-rises creating sophisticated urban living. These sought-after condos attract young professionals, downsizers, and investors with walkability to everything—from waterfront seawalls to world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment. Residents love the vibrant street life with trendy restaurants, brewpubs, cafes, and boutiques lining historic streets, plus proximity to False Creek for kayaking and seaside paths.

The area features diverse condo options from intimate heritage loft conversions with exposed brick to luxury high-rise towers with stunning water and mountain views. Yaletown's central location means walking or cycling to work downtown, quick SkyTrain access, and lifestyle amenities literally at your doorstep. Dog-friendly parks, farmers markets, and strong community atmosphere create neighbourhood feel despite urban density. Property values remain strong due to limited inventory and consistent demand.
